beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier moving through encode, window, repeated shared DQ-CTM thought ticks, and decode.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier is read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: ThinkSR separates the dense image field from the compact recurrent computation that updates it. The encoder first turns the low-resolution input into features. Windowing groups that dense field without discarding the spatial tokens. The DQ-CTM thought process runs repeatedly on the windows. The same DQ-CTM parameters are reused at each tick. The decoder turns the updated dense carrier back into the super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR updates a dense carrier with compact repeated thought
params.note: The recurrence stays inside the thought stage.

beats.intent: The carrier equation first makes a dense feature field, then partitions it into windows while keeping every token.
beats.narration: The carrier starts as a dense feature field, not as the compact thought state itself. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into that field. The window partition produces window tokens from the field while preserving the dense carrier as the object being updated.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded before it is windowed

terms.label: the encoder turns the low-resolution image into a dense feature field
the window partition keeps every token from the field

beats.intent: Among the five reported methods, DQ-CTM-SR is second largest by parameter count, not the cheapest option.
beats.claim: Table 1 reports CARN 1.592M, IMDN 0.715M, RFDN 0.550M, CATANet 0.535M, and DQ-CTM-SR 1.129M parameters.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison should be read as a size cost, not as a compression claim. CATANet is the smallest reported model. RFDN is only slightly larger than CATANet. IMDN sits below one million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR has 1.129 million parameters, making it the second largest of the five. CARN is the largest model in this comparison.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is second largest among the five methods
